sanskrit: सत्यमेव जयते नानृतं सत्येन पन्था विततो देवयानः।
translation: Truth alone triumphs, not falsehood; through truth the divine path of the gods is unfolded.
keywords: Satya, Truth, Dharma, Divine Path, Upanishad

sanskrit: ब्रह्म वा इदमग्र आसीत्तदात्मानमेवावेत्। अहं ब्रह्मास्मीति तस्मात्तत्सर्वमभवत्।
translation: Brahman was this universe in the beginning. It knew only Itself as 'I am Brahman (the Supreme Reality)', therefore It became all.

sanskrit: स य एषोऽणिमैतदात्म्यमिदँ सर्वं तत्सत्यँ स आत्मा तत्त्वमसि श्वेतकेतो।
translation: That which is the finest subtle essence, this whole universe has that as its soul. That is Reality. That is the Soul. That Thou Art, O Shvetaketu.
keywords: Tat Tvam Asi, Shvetaketu, Atman, Essence, Truth

sanskrit: कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन। मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि॥
translation: You have a right only to perform your prescribed duty, but never to the fruits of action. Let not the fruits of action be your motive, nor let your attachment be to inaction.
keywords: Karma, Nishkama Karma, Duty, Detachment, Action

sanskrit: बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते। तस्माद्योगाय युज्यस्व योगः कर्मसु कौशलम्॥
translation: Endowed with equanimity of mind, one frees oneself in this life from both good and bad deeds. Therefore strive for Yoga; Yoga is skill and poise in action.

sanskrit: असतो मा सद्गमय। तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय। मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय॥
translation: Lead me from the unreal to the real. Lead me from darkness to light. Lead me from death to immortality.

sanskrit: वायुः पित्तं कफश्चेति त्रयो दोषाः समासतः। विकृताऽविकृता देहं घ्नन्ति ते वर्तयन्ति च॥
translation: Vata, Pitta, and Kapha are the three doshas (bodily humors) stated in brief. When abnormal they destroy the body, and when in harmony they sustain it.
keywords: Vata, Pitta, Kapha, Tridosha, Physiology, Health

sanskrit: समदोषः समाग्निश्च समधातुमलक्रियः। प्रसन्नात्मेन्द्रियमनाः स्वस्थ इत्यभिधीयते॥
translation: One who possesses balanced humors (doshas), balanced digestion (agni), properly balanced bodily tissues (dhatus) and excretions (malas), and whose soul, senses, and mind are tranquil is designated as healthy (svastha).
keywords: Svastha, Health, Dhatu, Agni, Dosha, Tranquility

sanskrit: सर्वदा सर्वभावानां सामान्यं वृद्धिकारणम्। ह्रासहेतुर्विशेषश्च प्रवृत्तिरुभयस्य तु॥
translation: At all times, similarity of properties is the cause of increase of all substances, whereas dissimilarity is the cause of decrease. Both act through continuous application.
keywords: Samanya, Vishesha, Dravyaguna, Causation, Treatment Principle

sanskrit: नित्यं हिताहारविहारसेवी समीक्ष्यकारी विषयेष्वसक्तः। दाता समः सत्यपरः क्षमावान् आप्तोपसेवी च भवत्यरोगः॥
translation: One who constantly partakes of wholesome food and lifestyle, acts with circumspection, remains unattached to sensory overindulgence, is generous, impartial, truthful, forgiving, and heeds authentic teachers remains free of disease.

sanskrit: प्रयोजनं चास्य तन्त्रस्य स्वस्थस्य स्वास्थ्यरक्षणम्। आतुरस्य विकारप्रशमनं च॥
translation: The purpose of this medical treatise is the preservation of health in the healthy and the alleviation of disorder in the afflicted.

sanskrit: मखि भखि फखि धखि णखि ञखि ङखि हस्झ स्ककि किष्ग श्घकि किघ्व। घ्लकि किग्र हक्य धकि किच स्ग श्झ ङ्व क्ल प्त फ छ कलार्धज्याः॥
translation: Aryabhata's alphabetical mnemonic table defining twenty-four geometric sine differences (jya-ardha) in arcminutes for astronomical computation and trigonometry.
keywords: Aryabhata, Sine Table, Trigonometry, Jya, Computation

sanskrit: अनुलोमगतिर्नौस्थः पश्यत्यचलं विलोमगं यद्वत्। अचलानि भानि तद्वत् समपश्चिमगानि लङ्कायाम्॥
translation: Just as a person seated in a forward-moving boat sees stationary trees on the bank moving backward, so an observer at Lanka perceives the stationary stars as moving directly westward due to earth's rotation.
keywords: Earth Rotation, Celestial Sphere, Relative Motion, Stars

sanskrit: ग्रहाणां भ्रमणं वदन्ति भगणैः सहितास्तथा। सूर्यादीनां च सर्वेषां प्रत्यक्षं दृश्यते दिवि॥
translation: The revolutions of the planets alongside the stellar constellations are expounded; the orbital paths of the Sun and all heavenly bodies are visibly observed in the celestial dome.

sanskrit: अङ्कानां वामतो गतिरिति गणितशास्त्रे नियमः। शून्यं सर्वत्र योगे सममवतिष्ठते॥
translation: The place-value arrangement of numerical digits proceeds from right to left in mathematical computation. Zero added to any quantity leaves it unchanged.
keywords: Decimal System, Zero, Shunya, Place Value, Mathematics
